span.div:
Region A clock drifts 5
minutes ahead of Region B
Writes from B appear older
than they really are
Last-writer-wins discards
valid writes from B
Recovery: fix NTP,
replay audit logs

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Write spike causes
replication lag to
grow to minutes
Stale reads globally
Recovery: throttle

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Both regions accept
writes as primary
Data diverges
Conflicts on reconnect
Recovery: hours

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.div:
DNS updated but
resolvers cache
old record for
minutes or hours
Clients hit dead
region, see errors

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Region A fails
Traffic shifts to B
B is undersized, fails
All regions collapse
Recovery: graceful deg.
